about: The choices a dialog can remember (its 'Remember my choice' box): each key's id, its label, and its allowed values with labels. A key that has no remembered value means 'ask each time', the default of every key. The app's prefs/RememberedChoices.kt and the web's lib/choices.ts read these; Settings > Remembered choices lists them.
